name: How do I know if my toilet is leaking?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my toilet is leaking?

acceptedAnswer.text: A running toilet is a clear sign of a leak, but sometimes leaks are silent. To check for a silent leak, put a few drops of food coloring into the toilet tank. Wait about 15-20 minutes without flushing. If color appears in the toilet bowl, you have a leak, usually from a faulty flapper or fill valve. Other signs include a phantom flush, where the toilet flushes itself without anyone touching the handle, or unexplained high water bills.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check for leaks by putting food coloring in the tank; if color appears in the bowl after 15 minutes, you have a leak. Unexplained high water bills or phantom flushing also indicate issues.
